new_findings.title: Residual of B-002: availableSources still cannot represent the real binding of the step 'Choisis la taille' — the 'Limiter à un groupe précis' select only offers Toutes les options / Viande 1 / Sauce (1ère Gratuite)
new_findings.evidence: round-2 iframe DOM, data-testid=composer-step-source-ref: <option value=''>Toutes les options</option><option value='1'>Viande 1</option><option value='5'>Sauce (1ère Gratuite)</option>. No 'Taille', 'Viande 2' or 'Garnitures' group exists, while the steps list contains 'Choisis la taille', 'Viande 2', 'Choisis tes garnitures'. The misleading prices panel is gone (B-002 display fixed), but a gérant still cannot scope this step to its actual option group — and saving the panel could persist a source_ref that does not match what the kiosk really resolves.
new_findings.recommendation: Expose every attribute group of the category in the composer payload availableSources (Taille, Viande 2, Garnitures...), or pre-resolve and display the step's effective backend binding read-only when the group is not editable.

new_findings.title: Parent lock has no explanatory hint: the gérant editing Galette sees a select containing only 'Aucune' with zero explanation
new_findings.evidence: A4 DOM: the only hint under the select is the generic wizard note ('Le wizard d'une catégorie parente ne s'applique pas automatiquement à ses sous-catégories.'). Nothing says 'cette catégorie a des sous-catégories, elle ne peut pas devenir une sous-catégorie'. Round-1 A-001 recommendation explicitly asked for 'an explanatory hint'; only the option-filtering half was implemented. Backend rejection message exists (ItemCategoryHierarchyService.php:34-36) but would only surface on a crafted request.
new_findings.recommendation: When the edited category has children, render a small db-field-hint explaining why no parent is offered.

new_findings.title: Fix-introduced icon semantics drift: 'Dupliquer' now renders lab-add-circle-line (a circled plus), visually identical to an 'Ajouter' affordance
new_findings.evidence: A7a DOM: <button title='Dupliquer' aria-label='Dupliquer'><i class='lab lab-add-circle-line'>. PNG zoom of the Articles row shows ⊕ between the pencil and the trash. A sighted user scanning icons reads 'add', not 'duplicate'. Tooltip + aria-label mitigate (hence P3 per protocol).
new_findings.recommendation: Use a copy/duplicate glyph that renders (e.g. two overlapping squares) instead of the add-circle glyph.
